gaps.sentence: Several runners passed ___ in the heat.
This old house needs doing ___ before winter.
gaps.explanation: do up = repair and decorate a building. (British usage)

gaps.sentence: Do you get ___ well with your new colleagues?
gaps.explanation: get on (with) = have a good relationship; also get along with (AmE).

gaps.sentence: The new law will phase ___ disposable plastics by 2030.
gaps.explanation: phase out = gradually stop using something.

gaps.sentence: Wake ___ — you'll be late for school!
Don't ___ up all the milk — we need some for breakfast.
gaps.explanation: use up = finish the whole supply of something.
